question: What specific challenges does Naive RAG face that Advanced RAG attempts to address?
ground_truth: Naive RAG faces challenges in retrieval precision/recall (selecting misaligned chunks, missing crucial information), generation difficulties (hallucination, irrelevance, toxicity), and augmentation hurdles (disjointed outputs, redundancy, determining passage significance). Advanced RAG addresses these through optimized indexing, query enhancement, and better context integration.

question: Bagaimana hukum probabilitas total dijelaskan dan diterapkan dalam dokumen ini?
ground_truth: Hukum probabilitas total menyatakan bahwa P(B) = ∑ P(B|Ai) * P(Ai) untuk kejadian-kejadian Ai yang saling eksklusif dan lengkap.

question: Bagaimana cara kerja polymorphism saat sebuah metode di-overwrite?
ground_truth: Polymorphism memungkinkan metode yang di-override dipanggil sesuai tipe objek aktual. Misalnya, jika Student mewarisi Person dan override dance(), maka saat p.dance() dipanggil pada variabel Person p yang menunjuk ke Student, metode Student yang dipanggil.
